Derived from L2 text (no argmap). ## kram-p17 (17)
World-dissolution wishing, by own-rush, own-doubt-fear-named procedure then prohibition teaching; Yama created thus, then again doubt dissolving, great-goddess, that my world-fear she dissolve. // AgKs_17

premises.text: jagatsaṃhāreṇa praśamayitukāmaḥ svarabhasāt svaśaṅkātaṅkākhyaṃ vidhim atha niṣedhaṃ prathayasi | yamaṃ sṛṣṭvetthaṃ tvaṃ punar api ca śaṅkāṃ vidalayan mahādevī seyaṃ mama bhavabhayaṃ saṃdalayatām
